summary: The team is currently firefighting a persistent Outlook lockout while pushing forward the Knowledge website redesign and prioritising promotion of the Asia Star and Intelligent China programs over US partnerships.
summaryDetail: The immediate operational priority is resolving the Outlook account lockout caused by stale saved passwords—everyone must update credentials across all devices and confirm the backend unlock with JSB today to restore email access. In parallel, the Knowledge website redesign is at a critical feedback stage: Joseph, Julie, and the team lead need to hold a 30-minute working session to mark specific design feedback, after which Joker will revise the design; the agreed direction keeps the two-menu structure, integrates BCI/BSI index banners into the Knowledge section, and disperses videos by topic rather than a standalone section. On the marketing strategy front, the team has decided to prioritise promotion of the China-based Asia Star and Intelligent China programs, putting US partnerships on hold initially, with the Berkeley program as a possible third priority for the audit phase; conversion tracking setup and auditing remain open tasks that need attention. Upcoming commitments include promoting the Andrea and Katya spotlight videos on LinkedIn, YouTube, and the website by late October, attending the European Chamber Silver Economy event on Oct 29, sharing English case studies from Cathy, and sending the prepared email on the 2026 Sino-Swiss Economic Forum cooperation, where CKGSB will participate as a free Knowledge Partner with SwissCham.

Remove the standalone videos section and disperse videos by topic instead
Keep the two-menu structure (Knowledge menu and School menu), with School menu top right in gray

Do not add a stock-market ticker at the top of the homepage
Prioritize Asia Star and Intelligent China programs for promotion; put US partnerships on hold initially.
